sources.supports: OpenAI's model documentation lists GPT-5 nano cached input at $0.005 per million tokens, rather than the $0.01 added in models.dev.

notes: OpenAI's official model page lists cached input at $0.005 per million tokens, so the $0.01 value added in the recorded models.dev change is not the official price. The available official source does not date when that rate applied during the earlier period; no effective date is assigned.
